task: Bounded targeted follow-up for publicly accessible complete original 1984 S-8410P and 1985 S-8510P factory service manuals.

sources.finding: Public directory has year-labeled factory-service folders; folder names do not prove completeness.
Only downloadable manual entry is 1984 Fiero Electrical Troubleshooting.pdf; existing section already retained. No complete S-8410P in this index.
Only downloadable manual entry is 1985 Fiero 6E3 Emissions and Drivability.pdf; existing section already retained. No complete S-8510P in this index.

1984 entries are DIY, electrical, maintenance and owner publications; 1985 entries are 6E3, DIY and owner publications. Complete later-year 1986, 1987 and 1988 service files are separately listed and already preserved; they are not replacements for the missing years.
Publisher lists a licensed print reproduction of S-8510P, 1146 pages. This is bibliographic/acquisition metadata from a listing, not a downloaded or inspected complete manual; no purchase made.
Publisher/distributor listing identifies paper S8410P for 1984 Fiero. No complete public scan obtained and no purchase made.

additionalCandidate.finding: Vehicle-index HTML offers Repair and Diagnosis, Parts and Labor, and offline ZIP links. It was not identified as a cover-to-cover original S-8510P scan, so it is not counted as satisfying the factory-manual gap. No technical claim taken from this aggregator and no ZIP acquired.
